step1_analysis.description: A standard CMOS differential amplifier with an active current mirror load. In the context of the paper, this OTA is likely used as a comparator or charge-amplifier in the capacitive fingerprint sensor's readout circuit to detect the minute capacitance differences (e.g., 0.1 fF) between fingerprint ridges and valleys.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Integrated Capacitive Fingerprint Sensor With 32-bit RISC Microcontroller

sky130_expected.calculation: Av = gm1 * (ro2 || ro4). With Itail=43uA (PCHB=0.6V), gm1~341uS, Rout~232kOhm, Gain~79 V/V = 38 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard 5T OTA gain is limited by intrinsic device output resistance (lambda=0.1/V).

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm1 / (2*pi*CL). With gm1=341uS and CL=1pF, UGBW = 54 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on load capacitance; 1pF is a standard test load.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: PM = 180 + phase(UGBW). Dominant pole at output, non-dominant at current mirror node.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed for stability in closed-loop configurations.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMRR = Ad / Acm. Acm is limited by tail current source output resistance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical for a single-stage differential amplifier without cascodes.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = Itail / CL. With Itail=43uA and CL=1pF, SR = 43 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the tail current charging/discharging the load capacitor.

paper_reported.value: 1 mW (reported as 1 w, likely typo for whole sensor)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Only accounts for the single OTA, not the entire fingerprint sensor array.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC Gain, UGBW, Phase Margin, CMRR, Slew Rate, and Power of the 5T OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for 5T OTA
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* Global Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VPCHB PCHB 0 0.6

* ==========================================
* DUT 1: Open Loop (Gain, Phase Margin)
* ==========================================
XM3 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 N2 V_PLUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 N1 PCHB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM4 VO N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM2 VO V_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

V_IN_CM V_CM 0 0.9
V_IN_AC V_PLUS V_CM dc 0 ac 1
L1 VO V_MINUS 1G
C1 V_MINUS V_CM 1G
CL VO 0 1p

* ==========================================
* DUT 2: Common Mode (CMRR)
* ==========================================
XM3_C N2_C N2_C VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1_C N2_C V_PLUS_C N1_C GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5_C N1_C PCHB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM4_C VO_C N2_C VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM2_C VO_C V_MINUS_C N1_C GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

V_IN_CM_C V_CM_C 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
V_IN_AC_C V_PLUS_C V_CM_C dc 0 ac 0
L1_C VO_C V_MINUS_C 1G
C1_C V_MINUS_C V_CM_C 1G
CL_C VO_C 0 1p

* ==========================================
* DUT 3: Transient (Slew Rate)
* ==========================================
XM3_T N2_T N2_T VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1_T N2_T V_PLUS_T N1_T GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5_T N1_T PCHB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM4_T VO_T N2_T VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM2_T VO_T VO_T N1_T GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

V_IN_T V_PLUS_T 0 PULSE(0.4 1.4 1n 100p 100p 1u 2u)
CL_T VO_T 0 1p

* ==========================================
* Control Block
* ==========================================
.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Gain, UGBW, PM, CMRR)
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(VO)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VO))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let pm = phase_at_ugbw + 180
print pm

let cmrr_db = vdb(VO) - vdb(VO_C)
meas ac cmrr_dc find cmrr_db at=10

* 3. Transient Analysis (Slew Rate)
tran 1n 3u
meas tran t_rise trig v(VO_T) val=0.6 rise=1 targ v(VO_T) val=1.2 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(VO_T) val=1.2 fall=1 targ v(VO_T) val=0.6 fall=1
let sr_rise = 0.6 / t_rise
let sr_fall = 0.6 / t_fall
print sr_rise sr_fall

quit
.endc
